query: dfki dkt at semeval 2017 task 8 rumour detection and classification using cascading heuristics
sql:
SELECT p.corpus_id
FROM Papers p
JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
JOIN AuthorInstitutions ai ON a.author_id = ai.author_id
JOIN Institutions i ON ai.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE (i.display_name ILIKE '%dfki%' OR i.display_name ILIKE '%dkt%')
  AND p.title ILIKE '%semeval 2017 task 8%'
  AND (p.title ILIKE '%rumour detection%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%rumour detection%')
  AND (p.title ILIKE '%cascading heuristics%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%cascading heuristics%')
ORDER BY p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100
